# Command reference

<!-- Generated by @internal/docs (target: cli). Run `yarn fix` to update. -->

Run `tallyrelease <command> [flags]`; `--help` on any command prints its flags. Error codes are listed in [errors.md](errors.md) and config keys in [configuration.md](configuration.md).

## Global flags

| Flag                    | Description                                                | Default             |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| `-V, --version`         | output the version number                                  |                     |
| `--cwd <dir>`           | repository root                                            |                     |
| `--config <file>`       | config file                                                | `tallyrelease.yaml` |
| `--token <token>`       | forge token (default: GITHUB_TOKEN)                        |                     |
| `--remote <name>`       | git remote to push to and read the repository from         | `origin`            |
| `--verbose`             | print debug output                                         |                     |
| `--allow-local-plugins` | let pr, release, run and version load plugins.\<name>.path |                     |
| `-h, --help`            | display help for command                                   |                     |

## tallyrelease check

Validate config, plugins, units, graph and the plan.

```sh
tallyrelease check [flags]
```

| Flag              | Description                                                                  | Default |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--branch <name>` | plan for this branch (default: current)                                      |         |
| `--head <ref>`    | check this commit with the current config; pass --branch for its branch rule |         |

## tallyrelease graph

Print units and edges.

```sh
tallyrelease graph [flags]
```

| Flag                | Description                                        | Default |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`            | print JSON (same as --format json)                 |         |
| `--format <format>` | output format (one of `text`, `json` or `mermaid`) |         |

## tallyrelease affected

Compute the build set.

```sh
tallyrelease affected [flags]
```

| Flag                | Description                                         | Default |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--base <ref>`      | diff against this ref                               |         |
| `--json`            | print the affected document (same as --format json) |         |
| `--format <format>` | output format (one of `text`, `json` or `tsv`)      |         |
| `--out <file>`      | write the affected document to a file               |         |
| `--github-output`   | append outputs to $GITHUB_OUTPUT                    |         |
| `--tag <tag>`       | keep units with this tag (repeatable)               |         |

## tallyrelease plan

Compute the release plan (read-only).

```sh
tallyrelease plan [flags]
```

| Flag                | Description                                                                 | Default |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--branch <name>`   | plan for this branch (default: current)                                     |         |
| `--base <ref>`      | diff against this ref                                                       |         |
| `--head <ref>`      | plan this commit with the current config; pass --branch for its branch rule |         |
| `--all`             | also list released units outside the build set                              |         |
| `--json`            | print the plan (same as --format json)                                      |         |
| `--format <format>` | output format (one of `text` or `json`)                                     |         |
| `--out <file>`      | write the plan to a file                                                    |         |
| `--github-output`   | append outputs to $GITHUB_OUTPUT                                            |         |
| `--summary`         | write markdown to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, else print it instead of the table  |         |

## tallyrelease explain

Explain why a unit is affected and how it is versioned.

```sh
tallyrelease explain <unit> [flags]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `unit`   | unit id     |

| Flag                | Description                                   | Default |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--branch <name>`   | plan for this branch (default: current)       |         |
| `--base <ref>`      | diff against this ref                         |         |
| `--json`            | print the explanation (same as --format json) |         |
| `--format <format>` | output format (one of `text` or `json`)       |         |

## tallyrelease version

Write version files and changelogs of pending releases to the working tree.

```sh
tallyrelease version [flags]
```

| Flag              | Description                             | Default |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--branch <name>` | plan for this branch (default: current) |         |
| `--dry-run`       | print the files without writing them    |         |

## tallyrelease pr

Create, update and close release PRs of pending releases.

```sh
tallyrelease pr [flags]
```

| Flag              | Description                                      | Default |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `--branch <name>` | plan for this branch (default: current)          |         |
| `--dry-run`       | print the actions without pushing or editing PRs |         |

## tallyrelease release

Tag merged release PRs and create their GitHub releases.

```sh
tallyrelease release [flags]
```

| Flag              | Description                                      | Default |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `--branch <name>` | plan for this branch (default: current)          |         |
| `--dry-run`       | print the actions without tagging or editing PRs |         |

## tallyrelease run

Tag merged release PRs, plan HEAD, update release PRs and write the plan.

```sh
tallyrelease run [flags]
```

| Flag              | Description                                                                | Default |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--branch <name>` | plan for this branch (default: current)                                    |         |
| `--base <ref>`    | diff against this ref                                                      |         |
| `--dry-run`       | print the actions without tagging, pushing or editing PRs                  |         |
| `--out <file>`    | write the plan to a file                                                   |         |
| `--github-output` | append outputs to $GITHUB_OUTPUT                                           |         |
| `--summary`       | write markdown to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, else print it instead of the table |         |

## Flag rules

- `--json` and `--format` cannot be combined; the command exits with 2.
- `plan --summary` with JSON output (`--json` or `--format json`) needs `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`, since both would use stdout; otherwise the command exits with 2.
- `affected --tag` is repeatable and keeps units with at least one of the given tags.
- `--allow-local-plugins` (or `TALLYRELEASE_ALLOW_LOCAL_PLUGINS=true`) only matters for `pr`, `release`, `run` and `version`. These commands never load local plugins on a pull request head.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning                                                     |
| ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `0`  | Success, also for `--help` and `--version`.                 |
| `1`  | Error, printed as `error[E_*]: message` on stderr.          |
| `2`  | Usage error, such as an unknown flag or a missing argument. |

## Scripting

Use `--format tsv` or `--json` in scripts. The text layout may change between versions; changes to the `json`, `tsv` and `mermaid` formats are listed in the changelog. The JSON documents of `affected`, `plan` and `explain` have schemas exported as `@tallyrelease/cli/affected.schema.json`, `@tallyrelease/cli/plan.schema.json` and `@tallyrelease/cli/explain.schema.json`.
